overview.en:
Connect Codex to the official Superhuman Mail MCP server for email and calendar workflows.

Review email conversations and prepare replies using the connected mailbox context. Keep thread, recipient, and draft details explicit; a prepared reply is not a sent message.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
连接 Superhuman Mail，处理授权的邮件与日历工作。

结合已连接邮箱上下文查看邮件会话并准备回复，明确会话、收件人和草稿内容；准备好回复不等于已经发送。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this email thread and identify the response it needs.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这个邮件会话，并判断需要回复哪些事项。

starterPrompts.en: Find the recent emails about this project and extract follow-up items.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的近期邮件，提取后续事项。

starterPrompts.en: Draft a reply to this thread for me to review before sending.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个会话起草回复，发送前交给我审阅。
